christmas.label: Christmas
christmas.nzNotes: NZ Christmas is in summer (December). Expect outdoor dining, BBQs, seafood, and fresh salads alongside traditional roasts. Pavlova is the quintessential NZ Christmas dessert. Glazed ham and roast lamb are iconic. Summer fruits (strawberries, cherries) are in season.

birthday_kids.label: Birthday (Kids)

Bouncy castles and pass-the-parcel are classic. Lolly bags for going home are expected. Keep food simple and kid-friendly.

bbq_casual.nzNotes: The BBQ is central to NZ social life. Sausage sizzle is iconic. Lamb chops, marinated chicken, and seafood on the grill are common. Expect BYO drinks culture. Classic sides are coleslaw, potato salad, and bread rolls. Outdoor setting assumed — consider shade and seating.

wedding_reception.label: Wedding Reception
wedding_reception.nzNotes: NZ weddings often blend formal and relaxed styles. Outdoor and vineyard weddings are very popular. Pavlova is a common wedding dessert alongside the cake. NZ wines (Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc, Central Otago Pinot Noir) feature prominently. Speeches are a big tradition. Many weddings include Māori cultural elements (karakia, waiata, haka).

baby_shower.label: Baby Shower
baby_shower.nzNotes: NZ baby showers are typically relaxed afternoon affairs. Light food (finger food, afternoon tea) is standard. Gender reveal elements are optional but popular. Games like 'guess the baby item' and 'baby bingo' are common. Decorations tend to be pastel or themed. Non-alcoholic drinks are the focus, with options for those not pregnant.

easter.label: Easter
easter.nzNotes: Easter in NZ is in autumn (March/April). Cooler weather means roasts and warm dishes are popular. Roast lamb is the traditional NZ Easter centrepiece. Hot cross buns are central — often homemade. Feijoas are in season. ANZAC biscuits are a staple. Easter egg hunts for kids. It's a long weekend (Friday-Monday) so expect larger gatherings.
